subject: general
question: The President of India may be removed from office by impeachment for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**violation of the Constitution.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **President may be removed prior to his tenure through impeachment for violating the Constitution** of India by the Parliament of India.
 
• The procedure may start in either of the **two houses of the Parliament**.
 
• A decision to impeach the President has to be **passed by a two-thirds majority of the total number of members of the originating house. **
 
• It is** later sent to the other house.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• As reported by **Article 52 **of the Constitution of India, the President is the **chief of state of the Republic of India. **
 
• **Article 57** permitted the **re-election of the President.**
 
• The **president's ruler can be proclaimed under Article 356.​ **
